features.name: bold_phrase_count
features.definition: How many bold-formatted (**text**) phrases appear across the counter-argument comments?
features.spec: Parse OC_comments as JSON list of strings; if missing or malformed return null; empty list gives 0. For each comment count regex matches of r'\*\*(?=\S)(.+?)(?<=\S)\*\*' with re.DOTALL disabled (single-line spans); sum across all comments. Raw count, no semantic filtering.

h0: bold_phrase_count has no association with delta.
h1: Higher bold_phrase_count is associated with higher probability of delta (OP view change).
note: Persuasiveness is operationalized as the dataset outcome delta (OP changed view); association only. Count is summed across all comments in the row, not per-comment. Markdown asterisks may be altered in the supplied text; comment text may contain outcome announcements or quoted bold text from others (raw count, not filtered). Bold counts are sparse (mean ~0.24). Comment timing unknown.
